passages: Sections4.1–4.3: monotonicity, balance/spread/load assumptions, nearest-point interval construction and costs
Sections4.2–4.3: clockwise placement, virtual nodes and distinct physical preference lists
Section4.7: compare Merkle roots only for shared key ranges

limitations: Finite routing/refinement; no actual data handoff, global membership or production protocol equivalence.
Reference hashing integration is distinct from later learner integration; no physical observation.

rubric.criterion: Derive stable token/physical-owner identity, collision ties, membership and monotonic remapping under fixed existing tokens.
